items.title: Florian J. "Curly" Lizana Interview, 1966-05-18
items.q: I took Charlie and repair department.

ctx.x: Wait, maybe he'd rather get that on the tape. No, that's okay, go ahead. We've got this second reel on, so it's okay.
I came back here and I have, as usual, two, three jobs. One of them was with Whirline repair department. I took Charlie and repair department. And what were we talking about?
We're talking about Paul Whiteman and Roy Maxwell.
